verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot docs describe a 'desktop workspace' where users can launch work, track progress across multiple agents, and review changes/merge from one place, plus a centralized control page to jump between agent sessions — supporting side-by-side multi-session management. However, there's no explicit description of a visual diff viewer UI, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the desktop app's diff-review experience. Missing for 10: explicit visual diff-viewing UI details, hands-on/independent confirmation of desktop app usability for diff review and session switching.
